ProductionRecord.title: ProductionRecord
ProductionRecord.description: Monthly industrial manufacturing production, cost breakdown, and operational telemetry record for a specific plant and product line.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the record owner.

plantId.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing plant.

plantName.description: Human-readable name of the manufacturing facility.

productName.description: Name of the industrial equipment or product line.

productionLine.description: Production bay or assembly line code.

unitsProduced.description: Equivalent industrial units fabricated/processed in the month.

sellingPricePerUnit.description: Realized selling price per unit in USD.

revenue.description: Total realized revenue for the product in the month in USD.

budgetedCost.description: Standard budgeted total production cost for the month in USD.

rawMaterialCost.description: Direct raw material cost (steel plates, castings, tubes, alloys) in USD.

directLabourCost.description: Direct fabrication, machining, and welding labour cost in USD.

energyCost.description: Electricity, thermal furnace, and compressed air utility cost in USD.

maintenanceCost.description: Preventive and breakdown machine maintenance expenditure in USD.

logisticsCost.description: Inbound freight and heavy-haulage outbound logistics cost in USD.

inventoryHoldingCost.description: Working capital holding, storage, and insurance cost for WIP and raw stock in USD.

overheadCost.description: Allocated plant overheads, NDT quality assurance, EHS, and depreciation in USD.

machineHoursAvailable.description: Total scheduled machine capacity hours for the line.

rawMaterialInputTons.description: Gross metallic/raw material tonnage issued to shop floor.

rawMaterialNetTons.description: Net finished equipment weight in tons after cutting and machining.

energyKwhConsumed.description: Total electrical and thermal equivalent energy consumed in kWh.

benchmarkEnergyKwhPerUnit.description: Engineering standard energy consumption per unit in kWh.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated.

SavedScenario.title: SavedScenario
SavedScenario.description: User-configured what-if cost and profitability simulation scenario.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

targetSector.description: Sector filter applied to scenario ('ALL' or specific sector).

rawMaterialDeltaPct.description: Percentage change in raw material prices (-50 to +100).

energyDeltaPct.description: Percentage change in energy tariffs (-50 to +100).

volumeDeltaPct.description: Percentage change in production volume (-50 to +100).

labourDeltaPct.description: Percentage change in direct labour cost (-50 to +100).

sellingPriceDeltaPct.description: Percentage change in unit selling prices (-50 to +100).

projectedAnnualSavingsUsd.description: Net annual profit delta in USD relative to baseline.

OptimisationActionStatus.title: OptimisationActionStatus
OptimisationActionStatus.description: Tracks user execution status and notes for a cost-reduction recommendation.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user managing the initiative.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when status record was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when status record was updated.

/production_records/{recordId}.description: Stores monthly manufacturing cost and production telemetry records isolated by ownerId.

/saved_scenarios/{scenarioId}.description: Stores user-saved cost and profitability simulation scenarios isolated by ownerId.

/optimisation_statuses/{statusId}.description: Stores workflow approval and implementation statuses for cost-optimisation recommendations isolated by ownerId.
